title: Brand guideline overview
slide_intent: Show how guidance covers a whole identity because designers need to connect individual ingredients with their use in communication.
strategic_value: A shared guide covering marks, voice, color, portraits and layouts can help Duolingo extend beyond its app consistently.
demonstration: Nine miniature guideline pages form a three-by-three overview on green, covering story, logo variants and use, Plus, voice, secondary colors, portraits, movement and one-word headlines.
practical_value: Use the overview to identify the subjects a complete brand guide needs; consult full pages for detailed rules.

content_islands.name: Identity row
content_islands.spec: Place story, logo overview and logotype-use pages across the top.

content_islands.name: Ingredient row
content_islands.spec: Place Plus, Duo’s voice and secondary colors across the middle.

content_islands.name: Application row
content_islands.spec: Place portrait photography, illustrated movement and one-word headline layouts across the bottom.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying case study says a clear set of guidelines brought new elements together for use away from the app.
reference_purposes.Application: The contact sheet shows guidance spanning ingredients and applied layouts; it is an overview, not a substitute for full guideline pages.
